subject.title: feat(ui): live agent activity subtitles on running sidebar sessions

question: Should live sidebar activity remain an on-by-default server-synced preference, rather than a browser-local setting or an opt-in feature?
rationale: This choice expands the persisted user-settings contract and determines whether existing users receive live session narration immediately after upgrade.

options.title: Approve synced default-on preference
options.body: Keep the new synced default-on setting, provided fresh-install and upgrade behavior are explicitly verified.

options.title: Make the preference browser-local
options.body: Avoid extending the server-persisted UI preference contract while retaining the sidebar behavior per browser.

options.title: Require explicit opt-in
options.body: Ship the capability disabled by default if maintainers prefer not to expose session narration to upgraded users automatically.

recommendation.title: Approve synced default-on preference
recommendation.body: Keep the new synced default-on setting, provided fresh-install and upgrade behavior are explicitly verified.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent sidebar subtitle and attention precedence design.
